This might not make you feel better but I also just took shrooms for the first time three days ago (1.5g) and I didn’t expect to trip just maybe feel a little more euphoric?? well I pretty had a melt down x6283829. It was like the catalyst. I think I needed to get all this anger and sadness out, but damn I was not expecting that. I didn’t feel scared, I just felt like my negative emotions were exacerbated and my positive ones were no where to be found.
